description: Validate email for fraud risk — checks deliverability, disposable/temporary providers, honeypot traps, spam traps, leaked credentials, catch-all detection. Returns fraud score (0-100), SMTP verification, domain age, and abuse history. Goes beyond basic validation (IPQualityScore)

email.description: Email address to validate and check for fraud (e.g. "user@example.com")

fast.description: Skip SMTP verification for faster response (default false)

name: security.ipqs.email_check

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Email Fraud Detection
